test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9edb43ac92f328b45416994808aed586fb3d3c8601422d8cf2b855bd339cae92.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37311317dfa1c804a74ead28c7912f83eb7c2f23b8879422aae14cf073fd9c14.png] 

**The star moves between two places in every step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/107659f5f63a71329e261bbdb40a5ece91129c5f1c2ba5434371a5b71b7cdd15.png] 

**The letter at the far corners in every two step is deleted and a new alphabet is introduced which is placed at the middle left.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0666ce48ac93f4a2aee0e3d24f43fc8918805fa0ec1afdc6af350ddbed4526e.png] 

Next step:

**The star will be placed at the center.**

**There will be a new alphabet will be added which will be placed at middle left.**

** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34901489ef058f77c55d4e8c3f4c4fe8a9e6aec691eae7a9aea6f37a25d74d62.png] Now we consider the given options:

 

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e97facee0954b86d5121c8ca17a19371bc347c2aa2d5da5f8c4e596ef5e3d1ac.png] Star is not positioned correctly and no new alphabet is introduced.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e28d0dcc9b07302e711dbc7edd0452d3a9626521c58291a28fe732406a290f3d.png] No new alphabet is introduced.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e01414c489438b2919b50a314467b72fe046b4de11bed9ae84539fa239fd99ae.png] The positioning of 'S' and star is incorrect, also 'P' must be replaced by 'X'.

**Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34901489ef058f77c55d4e8c3f4c4fe8a9e6aec691eae7a9aea6f37a25d74d62.png] **The pattern is correct.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
